deployments_detail.use: DeepBrain AI 'AI Banker' virtual-human kiosks in branches: interactive AI avatars (built from real employees' voice/video) that greet customers, introduce financial products, guide use of ATMs/STMs and pre-writing services, and provide branch/weather/financial-tip info via speech, video and NLP. Piloted March 2021 at Yeouido HQ, commercialized/officially introduced Feb 2022. Uses KB's proprietary language model KB-STA. [DeepBrain AI (AI Studios); KB in-house KB-STA language model]

Generative AI Consultation Chatbot for staff: a generative-AI agent that assists bank employees during customer consultations by surfacing regulations, guidelines, product and service information, combining generative AI with existing machine-learning tech to improve consultation accuracy and efficiency. Built on the financial-consultation agent designated an innovative financial service by the FSC. Operational; bank plans to expand into customer-facing AI consultation. [KB Kookmin Bank (generative AI, FSC-designated innovative financial service)]

AI financial chatbot 'Bibi': an NLP-based conversational chatbot in KB Kookmin Bank's mobile/online channels providing personalized, simple consultation and product guidance to retail customers via chat, using the bank's AI capabilities. [KB Kookmin Bank (in-house NLP/AI)]

K-Bot Saem AI wealth management: robo-advisory service ('Robo Saem' / 'AI Portfolio') that recommends investment/financial products to retail customers. In 2025 AI recommendations drove 55% of new product subscriptions (vs 45% by human private bankers), reversing 2024's 36%/64% split; ~170,000 cumulative cases worth ~600 billion won ($440M) since 2018 launch. [KB Kookmin Bank (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 55% of new product subscriptions from AI in 2025; ~170,000 cases / ~600 billion won ($440M) cumulative

deployments_detail.use: KB GenAI Portal: the financial sector's first agentic-AI portal (established April 2024), running 250+ AI agents across ~39 key business areas spanning 8 subsidiaries (KB Kookmin Bank, KB Securities, KB Insurance, KB Kookmin Card, KB Life Insurance, KB Asset Management, KB Capital, KB Savings Bank). Supports tiered no-code to pro-code development. All 8 affiliates received regulatory 'innovative financial service' designation in Dec 2024. Plan to reach 300+ agents in 58 business areas by 2026. [KB Financial Group (group-wide generative AI platform)]
deployments_detail.value: 250+ AI agents across ~39 business areas, 8 subsidiaries

deployments_detail.use: KB Kookmin Commercial District Vitality Index: an AI/analytics service that uses the bank's banking and card transaction data to assess the vitality of commercial districts nationwide, supporting SME and commercial-real-estate insights. [KB Financial Group (in-house data/AI)]

KB Life Insurance company-wide Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment: full-scale rollout of M365 Copilot (after a six-month pilot) to an enterprise of 10,000+ employees for daily productivity workflows (email, meetings, documents, collaboration). Cited as Korea's first financial institution to achieve full company-wide Copilot adoption; enabled by 2024 regulatory sandbox network-separation exemption. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot, GPT-4 / Azure OpenAI)]

KB DAVIS: a personalized data-analysis AI agent that responds to natural-language queries by returning relevant data, analysis and visualized reports for employees; showcased as an operational internal AI service alongside the KB AI Lab launch. [KB Financial Group (in-house)]

Voice-phishing detection with LG Uplus AI call app 'ixi-O': KB Kookmin Bank links LG Uplus's AI-detected suspected phishing-pattern data with the bank's own abnormal-transaction data to enable real-time detection of phishing attempts and early action to prevent the spread of fraud losses. [LG Uplus (ixi-O AI call app) + KB Kookmin Bank]

Per-customer voice-phishing risk index: KB Kookmin Bank has begun internal work on an AI-based system to calculate a voice-phishing risk index for every customer, planned for rollout the following year, to flag and pre-empt fraud exposure. [KB Kookmin Bank (in-house AI)]

KB AI Dev Center: AI-powered software development environment where developers describe functions in natural language to generate/modify code, build prototypes, and run testing and security verification. Integrates Anthropic's Claude Code alongside other external AI tools; an in-house tool 'Harness' validates AI-generated code against bank security standards, with human final sign-off. [Anthropic (Claude Code); in-house Harness validation tool]
